verdict.rationale: Mastra documents explicit workflow snapshot/suspend-resume mechanics: storage persists execution state so runs can "pause indefinitely and resume where you left off," snapshots "capture all the information needed to resume a workflow from exactly where it left off," and suspend()/resume() APIs restart from the paused step. It also supports 'time travel' re-execution from any step using stored snapshot data, directly matching crash/restart recovery. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation of resume-after-crash (vs. voluntary suspend) and no detail on storage backend durability guarantees.
